WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key, login_state,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.member_key, w.order_member_key, w.login_state, f.net_amount, s.store_id, p.category
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
  count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl,
  sum(net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN l.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN (l.member_key IS NULL) <> (order_member_key IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN login_state='guest' AND l.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_with_member,
  sum(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' AND l.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_no_member
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  count(*) AS lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS logged_in_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS li_line_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND o.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS li_order_null,
  sum(CASE WHEN o.login_state='guest' AND o.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_order_member,
  min(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, max(f.sale_date) AS max_sale
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order) AS orders, (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS distinct_orders,
 (SELECT min(f.sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) AS first_null,
 (SELECT max(f.sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) AS last_null,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) AS null_lines,

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.sales_line_id, f.member_key AS line_member_key, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
rets AS (
    SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, o.member_key AS order_member_key, -r.refund_net AS net_amount
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  sum(l.net_amount) AS web_before_ret,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_before_ret,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/sum(l.net_amount),2) AS share_fixed,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/sum(l.net_amount),2) AS share_raw,
  sum(CASE WHEN l.line_member_key IS NOT NULL AND l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT m1.member_id FROM dim_member m1 WHERE m1.member_key=l.line_member_key) <> (SELECT m2.member_id FROM dim_member m2 WHERE m2.member_key=l.order_member_key) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_member
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS business_date, o.member_key AS mk, f.net_amount AS amt
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.member_key, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(amt) AS web_net_after_returns,
  sum(CASE WHEN mk IS NOT NULL THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS member_net,
  round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN mk IS NOT NULL THEN amt ELSE 0 END)/sum(amt),2) AS share_after_returns
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')), lines AS (SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
